subtitle.zh-CN: 黄色梨形奶蛙 · 灰色小手
subtitle.zh-TW: 黃色梨形奶蛙 · 灰色小手

description.zh-CN: 奶龙的网络二创版本，梨形的高个子，绿圈眼睛和一抹淡定的坏笑，什么都不在乎。
description.zh-TW: 奶龍的網路二創版本，梨形的高個子，綠圈眼睛和一抹淡定的壞笑，什麼都不在乎。
description.en: An internet remix of Nailong: tall and pear-shaped, with green-ringed eyes and a calm smug smirk. Nothing fazes it.

look: tall mustard-yellow pear / bean shape, small narrow head flows straight up from a big round pot belly with no neck, two small eyes set flat on the upper face (black pupil in a bright green ring), thin flat smug gray smirk line, large cream belly patch, dark gray mitten hands hanging down, long thin legs
